All 55 CSV members of evaluation.zip were inspected; they contain earlier AUT benchmark scores, not c002 randomized experiment records. Their model field identifies scoring methods and src identifies earlier studies; neither supplies treatment assignment. The c002 participant texts, exposure/disclosure assignments, chain positions and corresponding SBERT embeddings are absent. The paper does not identify the exact SBERT checkpoint. Consequently the same texts and embedding procedure cannot be recovered, and rule 5 precludes computing this set-level outcome from a substitute corpus or treating it as a participant-level score. Cannot reproduce the printed difference 1.210000 at PDF p. 22, Table 12, row 0. SI 8.1 (PDF p. 21) requires actual experiment ideas after response-chain trial six, 50 samples of 50 ideas per condition-item combination, cosine distances scaled by 100, and tests paired on item and Monte Carlo seed. Neither these eligible response sets nor their saved diversity values are present. Counts, arm levels and the reported difference cannot be reproduced from the supplied deposit.
